decisions.learningObjective: Explain lymphatic/interstitial expansion producing a circumferential periportal collar and distinguish its geometry from a duct.

decisions.learningObjective: Explain resuscitation-related lymph overload and interpret diffuse edema with IVC distention against focal traumatic blood.
decisions.rationale: Adds the volume-expansion causal pathway and structured trauma differential; image cases alone do not teach lymph production exceeding drainage.

decisions.learningObjective: Explain expected early posttransplant edema through disrupted lymphatic drainage while connections reform.
decisions.rationale: Adds the lymphatic postoperative mechanism; retained biloma/arterial-complication cards concern a different process. Repeated postoperative trap and high-yield rows were consolidated.

decisions.learningObjective: Explain embolized schistosomal eggs causing periportal fibrosis and echogenic portal-tract mantling on ultrasound.
decisions.rationale: Adds a source-supported histopathologic-to-ultrasound mechanism beyond the owned CT fissural-widening objective.

decisions.learningObjective: Explain dilated peribiliary glands as the origin of noncommunicating portal-parallel cysts.
decisions.rationale: Adds glandular origin/architecture; renal sinus noncommunication is a different organ and mechanism. Redundant US/CT/MR text pattern cards were consolidated.

decisions.learningObjective: Differentiate central pneumobilia from peripheral portal venous gas and identify the portal-venous spiky waveform.
decisions.rationale: Adds a structured cross-modality discriminator and source-verified portal Doppler feature; gallbladder gas/instrumentation pitfalls do not cover this liver vascular distribution.

decisions.learningObjective: Recognize contrast enhancement and thickening of bile-duct walls as supportive, nonexclusive evidence of ascending cholangitis.
decisions.rationale: Adds infection-centered contrast CT/MR wall assessment. Owned PSC wall activity concerns chronic sclerosing disease; current abscess images teach complications rather than this contrast-wall interpretation.

decisions.learningObjective: Recognize nonspecific starry-sky portal-triad echogenicity with gallbladder edema on ultrasound in acute hepatitis.
decisions.rationale: The retained hepatitis card explicitly lacks starry-sky ultrasound; this is a newly auditable, modality-specific appearance, not a paraphrase of its CT/MR edema answer.

decisions.learningObjective: Distinguish focal fatty sparing as a hypoechoic area within echogenic fatty liver with preserved vessel course on ultrasound.
decisions.rationale: Adds the ultrasound appearance of sparing relative to its fatty background. Owned CT/MR fat-distribution and chemical-shift cards do not teach this reversed sonographic contrast.

decisions.learningObjective: Recognize smooth highly reflective periportal hardware on ultrasound using procedure history.
decisions.rationale: Adds a source-supported ultrasound mimic of gas, stone and vascular calcium; the staged CT chemotherapy clips do not supply the same modality recognition objective.
